# Trigger catalogue — sprezzature-ui

**Generated by `scripts/build_triggers.py`. Do not hand-edit.** A test asserts this file equals the generated output, so a phrase added here and nowhere else fails CI.

Generates vanilla JS + Tailwind UI (components, pages, dataviz, audit).

## When this skill is the answer

**You are holding:** A screen to build: a page, a component, a form, a dashboard.

A phrase list cannot generalise — the ways to ask are unbounded, and a user almost never names the tool. What is bounded is the kind of thing in front of them. Match that first; the phrases below confirm a match, they do not make one.

Said without naming a tool: "build me a settings page", "I need a modal", "scaffold a landing page", "audit this UI", « une page pour… »

## When it is not

Not this one when: the thing to wrap is a command-line tool (sprezzature-cli-gui); the source is Markdown that must become a site (sprezzature-publish); or the HTML exists already and the question is whether it is accessible (sprezzature-accessibility), how it feels (sprezzature-ux-laws) or whether a colour passes (sprezzature-colors). The exhaustive trigger catalogue is in `references/triggers.md`.

## Every phrase that names this skill

- `build a UI`
- `create a component`
- `design a page`
- `make a form / modal / button / nav`
- `scaffold a landing`
- `build a web app`
- `audit this UI`

- `audit i18n`
